sentences.japanese: 孤独な人は、他人を恐れるから一人なのだ。
sentences.english: Every person who is alone is alone because they are afraid of others.

sentences.japanese: 恐い話が聞きたいなら、数週間前に私が見た夢のことを話してあげるよ。
sentences.english: If you want to hear a scary story, I'll tell you about a dream I had a few weeks ago.

sentences.japanese: 君のことばをきいていると死ぬのが恐ろしくなる。
sentences.english: Your words make me fear for my life.

sentences.japanese: 僅かな不注意が大惨事に繋がる恐れがある。
sentences.english: Slight inattention can cause a great disaster.

sentences.japanese: 恐ろしさが私の心に忍び込み、そこに残った。
sentences.english: Fear crept into my heart and settled there.
